summary: Refresh the agents roster only when a reader holds an older one, and count full refolds by cause

replay.detail: No claim replay or stored history changes.

schema.detail: No database schema, version or stored data changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or coordination changes; no coordinated upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: Responses are unchanged. The background refresher pauses at least 250 ms between refreshes, skips a refresh when the newest roster is already current, and an HTTP page at the current cut no longer asks for one. A fresh=true read waits for the next refresh.

downtime.detail: No additional service interruption or startup migration is required.

recovery.detail: Only volatile in-memory caches and counters change.
